source_notes: Extracted from onetwenty.com/biometrics via Playwright (client-rendered category tabs, similar to SiPhox this session) plus the homepage's fuller Immune & Inflammation summary, 2026-07-14. Corrected an earlier call: OneTwenty was initially written off as a non-candidate because its two DB tiers ('Annual Membership Standard' $499 and 'Annual Membership NY/NJ' $749) are explicitly the SAME panel -- but that's exactly the Rythm Health situation (one real product, no second bundle to combine with), not a reason to skip it. Migrated as a single-product vendor at the $499 standard price; the $749 NY/NJ price is a state-compliance surcharge on the identical panel, not a separate product (same treatment as other vendors' NY/NJ surcharge metadata, e.g. Marek). Excluded non-lab 'Smart Metric' wearable/device markers visible on the site (Resting Heart Rate, Daily Step Count, Blood Pressure, BMI, Sleep, Body Fat Percentage, CGM) -- those aren't blood draws. Got a complete, count-verified (32/32) Immune & Inflammation list from the homepage; the /biometrics page's own tab for that category only rendered 10 of 32 items with no working 'Load More' expansion for it specifically (worked fine for the other 4 tabs). Total 70 raw markers captured vs. the vendor's own '85 lab biomarkers to start' claim -- likely a few more exist behind further pagination not reached; treat as a solid floor, not a fully exhaustive catalog (same caveat as Superpower's partial 218/359 extraction this session).
